description: The BenchLeader Index leaderboard of large language models: a daily composite of independent public benchmarks, one row per model (its best reasoning-effort configuration) as on the homepage. Optionally rank by one category score (coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge…), list every model × effort configuration, or filter to open-weights models or one developer. Paged.

category.description: Rank by this category score instead of the overall Index, e.g. coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge, instruction, multimodal, long_context.

configurations.description: List every ranked model × reasoning-effort configuration rather than one row per model.

developer.description: Only models from this developer, e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek.

limit.description: How many rows to return (at most 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (use next_offset from the previous page).

name: get_leaderboard
title: BenchLeader leaderboard
